reason: I have a property sale lump sum sitting in NRO and the tax side in India and Canada worries me, so a free CA call before anything moves, a named AD bank and a fee only when the money lands lowers my risk. I would still check the rate against Wise and my own bank before confirming.
objection: Their 'published rate, no extra margin' may still be worse than what Wise or my bank gives, and on a big lump sum a rate gap would cost me far more than the CAD $199 fee.
would_change_my_mind: If the partner bank's rate shown before confirming was visibly worse than the mid-market rate by more than about 0.5 percent, or the free CA call turned out to be a sales pitch rather than a real tax-position check, I would walk away.
